id: title:VojtechBartos:remove unprompted answers and interview flags and two patches

review.posthog_relevance: Removes Slack App-specific feature flags and workflows, including unprompted answers, interview recruitment, and agent design relay, while retaining the remaining Slack App functionality.
review.reason: This chunk removes Slack App-specific feature flags and associated gating checks, including the unprompted-answers and interview-recruitment flags, and the Slack agent design relay workflow. The remaining Slack App functionality is preserved. This is a localized maintenance and cleanup change, not a systemic improvement or broader capability expansion.
review.uncertainty: The exact business reason for removing these features is not established by the code alone; it could be a deliberate feature removal or a cleanup after a feature was disabled. No test or release notes are provided to establish the benefit or risk of this removal.

observations.limitations: This chunk removes the unprompted-answers and interview-recruitment feature flags and their associated gating checks. The remaining code no longer checks these flags, and the relevant helper functions and their callers are removed.
